# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *

FOOD, POLYMER & PERSONAL CARE SOLUTIONS

# Welcome to our World of Emulsifiers and Stabilisers

[FOOD][32][POLYMERS][33][PERSONAL CARE][34]

With over a century of experience, we help customers create high-performing products and solve
formulation challenges through tailored solutions and close collaboration. Across food, polymers,
and personal care, our products support sustainability by reducing waste, improving raw material
efficiency, and extending shelf life – helping manufacturers optimise production and contribute to
responsible innovation.

Expertise and innovation 

Since 1917, Palsgaard has led the way in emulsifier development, inventing the world’s first
plant-based food emulsifier. Our specialists now operate from nine global application centres,
delivering tailored solutions for food, polymers, and personal care. From enhancing product
performance to exploring new trends and reformulating for changing market needs, we blend deep
technical expertise with a collaborative approach to deliver lasting value.

Driving ESG together

Responsibility and ESG are deeply ingrained in Palsgaard’s heritage. We help customers reduce food
waste, optimise raw material use, and extend shelf life, while also aiming to lower carbon emissions
and improve production practices. Within our own operations, we invest in renewable energy,
responsible sourcing, and resource efficiency, continually setting ambitious targets to benefit
people, planet, and society. Our RSPO SG-certified emulsifiers and alternatives can help you meet
your ESG goals and regulatory requirements.

Collaborative partnerships

We believe business is personal. By working closely with our customers, we gain a deep understanding
of your goals and challenges, co-creating solutions that make a real difference. Whether you’re
launching a new product, refining a process, or tackling production issues, our experts are with you
every step of the way. With Palsgaard, you gain more than an ingredient supplier – you gain a
committed partner focused on your success.

# Welcome to our World of Emulsifiers and Stabilisers

[FOOD][32][POLYMERS][33][PERSONAL CARE][34]

With over a century of experience, we help customers create high-performing products and solve
formulation challenges through tailored solutions and close collaboration. Across food, polymers,
and personal care, our products support sustainability by reducing waste, improving raw material
efficiency, and extending shelf life – helping manufacturers optimise production and contribute to
responsible innovation.

Expertise and innovation 

Since 1917, Palsgaard has led the way in emulsifier development, inventing the world’s first
plant-based food emulsifier. Our specialists now operate from nine global application centres,
delivering tailored solutions for food, polymers, and personal care. From enhancing product
performance to exploring new trends and reformulating for changing market needs, we blend deep
technical expertise with a collaborative approach to deliver lasting value.

> # Anmol Chemicals Pharmaceutical Excipients, Food Grade Chemicals BP USP IP EP Ph Eur FCC
> # Analytical Reagent Manufacturers
> 
> **Anmol Chemicals** is a manufacturer supplier exporter of Pharmaceutical Excipients, Food Grade
> Chemicals and it offers materials as per IP BP EP Ph Eur USP NF JP FCC Food Grade as per the the
> latest monograph at best prices. **Anmol Chemicals Group**, established in 1976, is the pioneer
> manufacturer of Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceutical Excipients, Some API, Food Chemicals in India.
> Anmol Chemicals Group has manufacturing facilities spread across Western India, representatives in
> Houston, Chicago USA and Dubai, UAE. We also have toll manufacturing units for processing
> chemicals in a few countries around the world. We make IP, BP, EP, USP, NF, Ph. Eur., JP, FCC or
> Food Grade, Analytical Reagent Grade, LR or Laboratory Reagent Grades and Pure Grades of various
> chemicals. All our items are analyzed to meet the required standards. **We can supply the product
> in grams for your laboratory trial and in tons for your plant scale jobs**.
> 
> **We manufacture Bulk Drugs / API, Excipients, Pharmaceuticals (IP BP USP NF Ph Eur EP JP),
> Specialty Chemicals (Pure/Reagent), Mineral Fortifiers (FCC). Our manufacturing facility is FDA
> approved and GLP, cGMP, ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO/IEC 17025, ISO22000, FSSC 22000, ISO45001, FSSAI,
> Kosher, HALAL, COPP, WHO-GMP certified and Written Confirmation (WC) is available. Solid materials
> can be customized for particle size, shape, and bulk density. We observe WHO Good Manufacturing
> Practices and Good Laboratory Practices. We are a government-recognized STAR Export House and
> "Authorised Economic Operator (AEO)" per Indian Customs.**
> 
> **All technical documents and DMF support available.**

[Anonymous][74] reviewed [Kunefe (A Sweet Cheese Pastry made with Kadaifi)][75]
I was really interested in making Kunefee. I lived in Turkey for 5 years and have enjoyed this
dessert very much. I saved this recipe because it’s baked and not cooked over the stove, the
traditional way. I started making the syrup a day ahead of time because from the online research it
needs to be cold before you pour it on “individual slices only”right out of the oven. From reading
the reviews on this post no one mentioned anything about the syrup not getting thick. I threw my
syrup out and did a lot of research for the right ingredients. The traditional ingredients are 1 cup
of water, 2 cups of sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Add Rose when syrup is done. You heat it on
medium until sugar is dissolved and when it comes to a nice gentle boil, simmer for 12 min. Then you
will notice it has thickened nicely. Traditional Kunefee does not require milk, confectioner sugar
or nutmeg. So I made some adjustments to my recipe and I was very pleased with the results.

[Anonymous][74] reviewed [Kunefe (A Sweet Cheese Pastry made with Kadaifi)][75]
I was really interested in making Kunefee. I lived in Turkey for 5 years and have enjoyed this
dessert very much. I saved this recipe because it’s baked and not cooked over the stove, the
traditional way. I started making the syrup a day ahead of time because from the online research it
needs to be cold before you pour it on “individual slices only”right out of the oven. From reading
the reviews on this post no one mentioned anything about the syrup not getting thick. I threw my
syrup out and did a lot of research for the right ingredients. The traditional ingredients are 1 cup
of water, 2 cups of sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Add Rose when syrup is done. You heat it on
medium until sugar is dissolved and when it comes to a nice gentle boil, simmer for 12 min. Then you
will notice it has thickened nicely. Traditional Kunefee does not require milk, confectioner sugar
or nutmeg. So I made some adjustments to my recipe and I was very pleased with the results.

ITA began with its founding in the 80s and grew up with its second generation of the family.

preservatives for food industry**, as it is more important selecting and researching instead of
manipulating the raw material.
We enjoy working. That's why, if we tell you that we carefully follow our production and your
products, you should believe us.

Our mission is become a point of reference among the [natural food preservatives manufacturers][24]

## NATURAL SHELF LIFE EXTENDERS FOR BAKERY, PASTRY AND DESSERTS? THEY ARE SURELY MADE IN ITA!

A few years ago we decided to produce only natural shelf life extenders - natural ingredients that
are used in recipes to achieve a specific goal, such as prolonging the life of baked goods, pastries
or desserts - or preserving their appearance longer. We took the opportunity to eliminate the
chemical components of traditional food preservatives and life extensions and we focused on the
products that you can find on our website and you can only buy from us. What a golden opportunity!

[Read more][27]
 
[[Surface mould, bye bye.]][28]

## SURFACE MOULD, BYE BYE.

It’s a natural aromatic preparation, which vaporizes before packaging, it is also used in organic
products and does not alter the smell and taste when the packet is opened: instead it cancels the
effect of the alcoholic "flush". The new Complesso Limone® SPK is the killer of surface moulds and
is a signature product of ITA FOOD IMPROVERS®.

[Read more][29]

#### MedWin Publishers

Medwin is your gateway to a world of scientific and medical insights, striving to make research
accessible to everyone. We are a global, open-access publisher that publishes articles from
researchers worldwide, emphasizing the latest discoveries in various scientific fields. Our
commitment is to share significant works, including case studies and reviews, and create a strong
platform for researchers and readers globally. Medwin aims to contribute to the global intellectual
landscape by providing profound insights into the latest advancements in scientific research. Our
mission is simple: illuminate the latest findings and create a space where researchers from every
corner of the globe can connect and share ideas.

#### About Us

At Medwin, we're on a mission to make science and medicine understandable and available to all. We
publish original articles that showcase the latest discoveries in a variety of fields. Our goal is
to create a platform for researchers worldwide, transcending borders to share knowledge. We're not
just a publisher; we're a bridge connecting research from every part of the world. Our aim is to
bring the best research to light and share it with the global community.

#### Vision

We dream of being a catalyst for scientific knowledge across all fields. Medwin is a team that
believes in unity, working together to simplify communication and optimize research. We're here to
bring top-notch research to the forefront, covering advanced topics in science and engineering
around the world.

#### Aim & Scope

Medwin's main goal is to cover the latest in scientific progress. We want to contribute to knowledge
by promoting quality research. Our mission is to publish excellent, peer-reviewed work in all
emerging fields of science. We're committed to exploring daily research updates, strengthening
scientific knowledge, contributing to research progress, and providing a high-quality online
platform for original research.

#### Objectives
* **Explore Daily Research:** Medwin is dedicated to keeping up with daily developments in the
  scientific field, keeping you informed about the latest breakthroughs.
* **Strengthen Scientific Knowledge:** We aim to make science understandable and exciting for
  everyone, building a community passionate about research.
* **Contribute to Scientific Progress:** Medwin actively contributes to research progress by
  providing a platform for groundbreaking findings.
* **Provide a High-Quality Platform:** Our commitment to quality extends to providing a robust
  online platform for original research, ensuring the knowledge we share is top-notch.

#### Publication Model

Scholarly publishing, regardless of the medium, entails significant expenditures beyond mere content
creation. Publishers contribute value through a range of essential services, including the
production of documents across various formats, editorial and design work, marketing, and the
facilitation of connections between readers and authors. Each of these activities incurs costs.
Consequently, even non-profit publishers must not only recoup these expenses but also generate a
financial reserve to sustain their operations.

In response to the evolving landscape of scientific publishing, which seeks to enhance the
readership, accessibility, and impact of scholarly research, numerous journals are transitioning
from the traditional subscription-based model to an Open Access (OA) paradigm. Within the gold OA
framework, articles are made freely accessible online upon publication, eliminating paywalls.
Instead, the financial responsibility for publication shifts to the authors’ institutions or funding
organizations, which cover the Article Processing Charge (APC) once the manuscript is accepted.

#### MedWin Publishers

Medwin is your gateway to a world of scientific and medical insights, striving to make research
accessible to everyone. We are a global, open-access publisher that publishes articles from
researchers worldwide, emphasizing the latest discoveries in various scientific fields. Our
commitment is to share significant works, including case studies and reviews, and create a strong
platform for researchers and readers globally. Medwin aims to contribute to the global intellectual
landscape by providing profound insights into the latest advancements in scientific research. Our
mission is simple: illuminate the latest findings and create a space where researchers from every
corner of the globe can connect and share ideas.

#### About Us

At Medwin, we're on a mission to make science and medicine understandable and available to all. We
publish original articles that showcase the latest discoveries in a variety of fields. Our goal is
to create a platform for researchers worldwide, transcending borders to share knowledge. We're not
just a publisher; we're a bridge connecting research from every part of the world. Our aim is to
bring the best research to light and share it with the global community.

#### Vision

We dream of being a catalyst for scientific knowledge across all fields. Medwin is a team that
believes in unity, working together to simplify communication and optimize research. We're here to
bring top-notch research to the forefront, covering advanced topics in science and engineering
around the world.

#### Aim & Scope

Medwin's main goal is to cover the latest in scientific progress. We want to contribute to knowledge
by promoting quality research. Our mission is to publish excellent, peer-reviewed work in all
emerging fields of science. We're committed to exploring daily research updates, strengthening
scientific knowledge, contributing to research progress, and providing a high-quality online
platform for original research.

#### Objectives
* **Explore Daily Research:** Medwin is dedicated to keeping up with daily developments in the
  scientific field, keeping you informed about the latest breakthroughs.
* **Strengthen Scientific Knowledge:** We aim to make science understandable and exciting for
  everyone, building a community passionate about research.
* **Contribute to Scientific Progress:** Medwin actively contributes to research progress by
  providing a platform for groundbreaking findings.
* **Provide a High-Quality Platform:** Our commitment to quality extends to providing a robust
  online platform for original research, ensuring the knowledge we share is top-notch.

#### Publication Model

Scholarly publishing, regardless of the medium, entails significant expenditures beyond mere content
creation. Publishers contribute value through a range of essential services, including the
production of documents across various formats, editorial and design work, marketing, and the
facilitation of connections between readers and authors. Each of these activities incurs costs.
Consequently, even non-profit publishers must not only recoup these expenses but also generate a
financial reserve to sustain their operations.

In response to the evolving landscape of scientific publishing, which seeks to enhance the
readership, accessibility, and impact of scholarly research, numerous journals are transitioning
from the traditional subscription-based model to an Open Access (OA) paradigm. Within the gold OA
framework, articles are made freely accessible online upon publication, eliminating paywalls.
Instead, the financial responsibility for publication shifts to the authors’ institutions or funding
organizations, which cover the Article Processing Charge (APC) once the manuscript is accepted.

packaging, automotive, and construction applications, as well as the need for longer-lasting
materials. Regionally, Asia-Pacific is expected to experience the fastest growth, followed by North
America and Europe

## **About Our Company**

**

**
** **

Any food can be made tastier and healthier if the right ingredients in appropriate quantities are
used in them. Thus, we, **Rejoice Life Ingredients,** bring forth an infinite variety of food
ingredients. ***Vital Wheat Gluten, Soya Flour, Sodium Caseinate, Cookie Improver, Ice Cream,
Stabilizer, Wheat Fiber, Apple Fiber, L- Glutamine, Guar Gum ***etc., are a few of the food
ingredients we offer. We started this business journey as a **Manufacturer, Importer, Trader,
Wholesaler, Distributor and Supplier** in the year **2016** with the objective of becoming the
largest business entity of this sector. Thus, we make these food ingredients using substances that
are natural, organic and of the finest quality. These food ingredients are added in any food to make
it tastier, healthier and aromatic. For the processing of these ingredients, a well built hygienic
manufacturing plant has been built by us.

**What We Deal In?**

Our company is involved in the production, import, trade, distribution, supply and wholesale of a
wide variety of food ingredients such as the ones mentioned below:

**Our Processing Unit**

For the processing of these food ingredients, a high tech processing unit has been built by us. The
first thing that we take care of at our processing unit is its hygiene value. Our workers make every
effort to keep the place clean all the time so that impurities like pests, insects, dust, germs,
bacteria etc., are not able to spoil the food's quality. Only sound processing mixers, blenders and
food processing machines are installed at our plant that are time to time serviced to
eliminate possibilities of breakdown.

**Our Quality, Our Priority**

Even the slightest form of compromise with the quality of the food ingredients can have negative
impacts on the health of the consumers. And, so we never compromise with our products quality and
have always made quality our priority. The first grade ingredients that are used to make guar gum,
etc., are of the finest quality, pure, organic, nutritious and healthy as we test it
several norms before their dispatch.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

exporting, importing, trading, and bulk supplying high-quality raw materials for the Agrochemical,
Bio-stimulant, Fertilizer, and Micronutrient industries.

We offer an extensive portfolio of premium products, including entire range of Plant Growth
Regulators (PGRs), Active Ingredients, Adjuvants, Surfactants, Emulsifiers, Solvents, and much more.
Our specialized range also features Seaweed Extracts, Potassium Humates, Humic and Fulvic Acids,
entire range of  Chelated and sulphated Micronutrients,Plant Nutrients, Hormones, Enzymes, Oxines,
Growth Boosters, and Essential Oils, all designed to meet the evolving needs of the agricultural
industry.

In addition, we supply a variety of spray adjuvants such as Silicon Sprayders,Wetting Agents,
Dispersing Agents, Carriers, Emulsifiers, Preservatives, Stabilizers, Thickeners, Antioxidants, and
Anticaking Agents. Our offerings also include essential chemicals and specialty additives, ensuring
comprehensive solutions for all related industries.

### DL-Panthenol: A versatile B5 repair active ingredient

## *About Us*

Within the world of fine chemicals, **Yasho Industries Limited** manufactures performance chemicals
for industries as diverse as **Rubber & Latex**,** Food & Flavors**, **Perfumery**, **Lubricants**
and other **Specialty applications** since 1993.
 
Our strength in organic process **technology** enables us to develop sustainable manufacturing
processes to deliver **quality products** for our customers. The manufacturing facilities located in
Vapi, Gujarat is 200 km from the port which allows us to serve customers throughout the globe.
 
We test our products extensively in our well equipped lab that help our customers to produce high
quality products and succeed through trusted **expertise**,** confidence**, **global supply** and
**independent strength**.
 
Sustained focus on **research**, **development** and** innovation** has helped us to expand our
product range. Our engineering and process teams have designed multipurpose plants which allows us
to manufacture more than 100 products and fulfill our customer’s quality and volume requirements.
Our R&D facility is recognized by **DSIR**, Department of **Science & Technology**, **Government of
India**.
 
As a company, we take great pride in **contributing to the communities** where we live and work in
harmony with the demanding environmental needs.

## *About Us*

Within the world of fine chemicals, **Yasho Industries Limited** manufactures performance chemicals
for industries as diverse as **Rubber & Latex**,** Food & Flavors**, **Perfumery**, **Lubricants**
and other **Specialty applications** since 1993.
 
Our strength in organic process **technology** enables us to develop sustainable manufacturing
processes to deliver **quality products** for our customers. The manufacturing facilities located in
Vapi, Gujarat is 200 km from the port which allows us to serve customers throughout the globe.
 
We test our products extensively in our well equipped lab that help our customers to produce high
quality products and succeed through trusted **expertise**,** confidence**, **global supply** and
**independent strength**.
 
Sustained focus on **research**, **development** and** innovation** has helped us to expand our
product range. Our engineering and process teams have designed multipurpose plants which allows us
to manufacture more than 100 products and fulfill our customer’s quality and volume requirements.
Our R&D facility is recognized by **DSIR**, Department of **Science & Technology**, **Government of
India**.
 
As a company, we take great pride in **contributing to the communities** where we live and work in
harmony with the demanding environmental needs. 

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
***Research and  Development                                                                       
is  our core strength.                                                                             
                                                                                                   
                                                                                                   
Continuous Innovation, Process Upgradation                                                         
and Product Enhancement complement                                                                 
our vast experience                                                                                
of over 2 decades .***
